title: Great for Camping or During a Power Outage
text: Great for Camping or During a Power Outage. This was not quite as tall as I expected, and the fan is small.  For a small fan, it has good air flow and 3 speeds, as well as feature for rotation if you want it to rotate.  Also has 3 levels of night light if you want it.  Because this is USB rechargeable, you don't need a cord to run it, which means you could use it when camping or when there is a power failure, and your air conditioner isn't running.  It is a nice little fan.  It is important to realize there is an overall master on/off switch on the side of the base and then operating buttons on the top of the base.  Haven't run it long enough to see how long a charge lasts, but according to the specs it should run a number of hours.  You can collapse this for easy storage.  I am impressed overall with the fan and might get another one.
